verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs say you can set up a business number in minutes and that each plan includes a new local or toll-free number per user. It also offers Canadian local and vanity numbers, which covers the 'get a local number quickly' core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a search of available numbers by area code. missing for 10: documented search or filter of available numbers by area code, a described number-selection and purchase flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the 'minutes' claim.
